messages.共鳴で貯めた「引き裂かれた追憶」で呼吸とクリティカルダメージを伸ばし、2コイン目: A Pierce E.G.O that uses Torn Memory built from Resonance to raise Poise and Critical damage, dealing heavy damage with a Critical Hit on its second Coin.
messages.引き裂かれた追憶: 攻撃前に(最大共鳴数+1)を得る(最大7)。該当共鳴が完全共: **Torn Memory**: Before attacking, he gains (highest Resonance + 1), up to 7. If that Resonance is Absolute Resonance, (highest Resonance + 2). It maxes out at 6 Resonance or 5 Absolute Resonance and all disappears after the attack.
messages.呼吸とクリティカル: 追憶1につき呼吸を得て(最大3、解析Ⅲで4、Ⅳで7)、2コ: **Poise and Critical Hits**: He gains Poise per Torn Memory (up to 3, 4 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 7 at Ⅳ), and the second Coin gains Critical damage per Torn Memory (15% each at Threadspin Ⅳ, up to 105%).
messages.クリティカル依存: 2コイン目のクリティカルで沈潜3を付与し、弾丸を持っていれば: **Reliance on Critical Hits**: The second Coin's Critical Hit inflicts 3 Sinking, and if he has Ammo, he gains 1 Ammo on a kill (3 times per battle at Threadspin Ⅳ). Missing the Critical Hit wastes its potential, so Poise support is essential.
messages.パッシブ「潰されたペンダント」: 戦闘開始時、最大共鳴が3以上なら呼吸3を得る。: **Passive — Crushed Pendant**: At Combat Start, gains 3 Poise if the highest Resonance is 3 or more.
messages.傲慢などで共鳴を作り、呼吸を別手段でも稼ぐ人格で使う。呼吸が足りないと2コイン目: Build Resonance with Pride or similar, and use it with an Identity that also earns Poise by other means. Without enough Poise, the second Coin rarely crits.
messages.侵蝕スキルは共鳴と呼吸でダメージ量が上がる広域だが、呼吸を5消耗し、クリティカル: The Corrosion skill is a multi-target attack whose damage grows with Resonance and Poise, but it spends 5 Poise and has no Critical Hit effects.
messages.Ⅲ: 呼吸の上限が4になり、クリティカルダメージ量(追憶1につき10%)と出血が: **Ⅲ**: The Poise cap becomes 4, and Critical damage (10% per Torn Memory) and Bleed rise.
messages.Ⅳ: 呼吸の上限が7、追憶1につき15%になり、攻撃前に呼吸回数も1増える。: **Ⅳ**: The Poise cap becomes 7, 15% per Torn Memory, and Poise Count also increases by 1 before attacking.
messages.終止符事務所フィクサー: S2(嫉妬)・S3(傲慢)で資源を出せ、S1〜S3で呼: **[Full-Stop Office Fixer](persona:0711)**: S2 (Envy) and S3 (Pride) supply resources, S1–S3 earn Poise on their own, and he can make use of the Ammo from Critical kills.
messages.ピークォド号銛使い: S1(傲慢)・S2(嫉妬)・守備(憤怒)で必要資源の3種を: **[The Pequod Harpooneer](persona:0707)**: S1 (Pride), S2 (Envy), and his Defense skill (Wrath) supply all three required affinities, S1 and S2 earn Poise, and S1 also inflicts Bleed.
